limitations: Official IJCNN1 data and selected-positive construction are used, but the RBF basis count, CV folds, and hyperparameter grids are reduced for smoke execution.
The clean-room optimizer corrects the official objective-gradient regularization mismatch by using 0.5 * lambda * ||b||^2.
The densratio comparator uses 20 kernels and a reduced 2 x 2 grid for smoke execution.
The released 3,000-row holdout has only 315 positives at seed 2018, so priors 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8 cannot construct the requested 1,000-row test set without changing the protocol.
